propertyTaxRate.note: American Samoa levies no territorial real property tax; A.S.C.A. Title 11 (Revenue) has no real property tax chapter and the ASG Tax Office administers income tax only. Rate 0 is correct.

jurisdictionNote.note: Empty programs array is correct; no program exists. Absence is established from the structure of Title 11 and the Tax Office page, not from a statute stating it in words.

sources.title: American Samoa Code Annotated by Title and Chapter (ASBA): Title 11 Revenue chapter list, no real property tax chapter
American Samoa Government Tax Office (income tax only)

summary: American Samoa has no real property tax and therefore no veteran property tax exemption; the file's empty program list and zero rate are correct. Nothing changes for TY2026 or TY2027.
